text:
Ana: Heads-up — I'm proposing an enrichment-slab consolidation to merge Enforcer + Enricher into a single low-latency slab. Posting a brief sketch and rollout safeguards.

Devon: Can you drop the sketch/RFC link? :eyes:

Ana: https://r.redwood.internal/rfcs/enrichment-slab (sketch). TL;DR: collapse two hotpath services to remove an RPC and reduce CPU tail pressure. Keep logical interfaces, deploy behind feature-flag + canary.

Mika: Main concern: cache ownership and staleness. If we move both, who owns incremental KV updates? Need single source-of-truth to avoid stale prefix reads.

Sachin: Migration pattern that worked before: shadow traffic, monotonic backfill, then cutover. Add per-tenant opt-in so we can quickly roll back noisy tenants.

Jules: From an SLA perspective what does rollback look like if the fused slab errors at scale? We need explicit steps that don't require DB rollbacks.

Ana: Rollback plan: 1) flip feature flag to route to legacy path, 2) trigger short circuit-break on slab calls, 3) scale legacy services if necessary. No DB schema changes in phase 1.

Devon: We need a canary gating query and SLOs. Proposed metrics: p99 latency, 99.99% success rate, CPU per-pod delta, tail queue depth, and unit-cost delta to validate savings.

Mika: KV ownership rule suggestion for RFC: fused slab becomes authoritative for enrichment prefixes only after backfill completes. Until then keep consulting legacy cache with strict TTL to avoid split-brain.

Sachin: DB migration note: if we add an owner column implement as additive nullable column; background migration sets tenant pointer; switch routing only when pointer is set. Suggested migration window 48-72 hours with monotonic backfill.

Jules: Add rollout guardrails: 1% global canary, monitor 15m, then 10% for 1hr, 50% for 3hr, then full. Auto-rollback if error rate increases >0.5% absolute or p99 regresses >30%. Add to runbook.

Ana: Router snippet for feature flag check: 
```
if (featureFlags.enrichment_slab && tenantOptIn(tenant)) {
  callEnrichmentSlab(req)
} else {
  callEnforcer(req)
  callEnricher(req)
}
```

Devon: Add a "grace mode" where we forward a copy to the legacy path during 50% stage for 24h to detect output drift. Diff-based alerts and sampled diffs stored for analysis.

Mika: Also add circuit-breaker pattern and warmup: pre-warm KV prefixes for canary tenants, and gate max concurrent enrichment requests per-pod to protect downstream.

Sachin: Observability items: tag traces (enrichment_slab=true), store sampled response diffs to S3, and emit cost telemetry. Need Console dashboards: per-tenant error, p50/p95/p99 latencies, and output-diff ratio.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled for 1719480000; please include feature-flag config in the deploy PR.

Jules: Owners and action items?

Ana: Action items:
- Ana: finalise RFC with KV ownership section by EOD Fri (1719465600).
- Devon: canary SLO definition + dashboards by Mon (1719552000).
- Mika: migration script prototype + backfill plan by Tue (1719638400).
- Sachin: runbook rollback steps + migration checklist by Tue.
- Jules: schedule cross-team dry-run and postmortem template.

Ana: If no objections I'll mark RFC as ready-for-review and open staging PR. Thanks :tada:
